editions.name: cqr2's Playground
editions.editorial: The throne remains empty while mortals scramble over coins. ! sirlos leads with 13895 coins and survived a bounty to keep 502 more, yet war drums on the border sent every portfolio into freefall. Hexagon Insurance opened at 119.66 coins per share. A heatwave and rain both rolled over the realm. 𝗧𝗼𝗻𝗺𝗼𝘆 carries a 1125 coin bounty from the Long Hunt, and rebellion sits at 1 percent. Pathetic.

editions.name: Game is Life 2.0
